memory_records.title: Megan Campaign HQ upgraded UI shell verified across core screens
memory_records.content: On 2026-03-19, upgraded UI bundle was applied and verified locally. Home shows prioritized recommendation cards and operational counts; Command Center loads; Signals page shows titled rows with detail panel and status buttons; Actions page shows create form, selected action panel, and styled status badges; Relationships page shows create form plus rendered relationship graph and list; Entities page shows create form and entity list; Recommendations page shows priority badges and convert-to-action buttons. A Next hydration warning was observed once showing html style mismatch, likely caused by client-side DOM mutation/extension rather than app transport failure, since pages render and function afterward.

memory_records.title: Megan Campaign HQ locked backend state
memory_records.content: Backend core and auth layer are complete and stable for Megan Campaign HQ. Stack: Fastify (Node + TS), Supabase Postgres prod project megan-hq-prod, Supabase Auth JWT middleware. Canonical DB tables: intake_items, signals, actions, entities, relationships, operators, campaign_memberships. API source of truth: apps/api/src/app.ts. Public routes: GET /health, /api/home, /api/intake, /api/signals, /api/actions, /api/entities, /api/relationships, /api/recommendations. Protected routes: POST /api/intake, PATCH /api/signals/:id, POST /api/actions, PATCH /api/actions/:id, POST /api/entities, POST /api/relationships. Auth enforcement via authenticateOperator and requireOperator backed by operators and campaign_memberships. Verified: authenticated writes work, anonymous writes blocked, Supabase JWT validation works. No SQLite, no auth bypass, no direct frontend DB access, no API shape changes without schemas update, no frontend build before UI spec. Current phase is end of backend core + auth; next required phase is Phase 12A UI spec before any UI build.
